title: From notebook to script: parameters, functions and a project that runs elsewhere

videos.script: The notebook found the answer. Now somebody wants it every month, for a different station each time. {{monthly}} The notebook cannot do that without you sitting in front of it. {{without}} So the work moves into a script. {{script}} The first try is JupyterLab's own converter, and it fails on the second line. A notebook speaks a little more than Python. {{convert}} The second try is a rewrite. Each cell becomes a function, each value typed into a cell becomes an argument, and a main joins them. {{rewrite}} Then it meets the world outside the notebook. A station that does not exist. A file run from another folder. A computer with other versions of pandas. {{world}} The notebook stays, for the next question. The script is how the last answer gets made again. {{end}}
